shape: small things you did without thinking as a kid that take nerve now, each told as what you did, never as advice

slides.text: small things in our first flat that take nerve today
taking [[a slice of toast]] off your plate before you even sat down at the table
pushing your bedroom door open at midnight just to tell you one silly thing
standing in the kitchen in my socks to ask if an email sounded too angry
borrowing your heavy winter coat to run to the corner shop without asking
sitting on the cold radiator and saying [[i only have four pounds left]] until friday
tiptoeing into your bedroom to click off your lamp because you fell asleep mid-sentence
save this for the person who shared a tiny hallway with you before life got quiet

caption:
we split the gas bill and argued over whose turn it was to buy bin bags, but neither bedroom door was ever shut.
living with an old flatmate when you have nothing makes you braver than you know.
save this for a sunday afternoon when you miss having someone one wall away.
